messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Standard Bank strongly recommends that all customers upgrade their browsers to this new update, regardless of whether they have experienced this bug.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Please" <BLINK: CLICK HERE>" To Activate Your Account and Migrate to the new Microsoft Exchange 2014.', 'Please click verify to confirm your account to our new Online Banking system.', 'Wherever, always try to ensure the latest antivirus, firewall and browser soph...', 'click on the link below to Set Up Mobile Alert for your webmail account.', 'We strongly advise that you take a little time to do the routine security upgrade on your email to avoid theft and loss of personnel files.', 'Please note that in order to use LLOYDS TSB InternetBanking service you must enroll in our new Security updates.', "You'll need to add our site to the Compatibility View List:Click on toolsScroll & click on compatibility view settingsType in our address (www.s2b.standardchartered.com)Click add"]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
